Here are the visual differences between the original (Image 1) and the clone (Image 2):

**Layout & Spacing:**
*   **Text Wrapping:** In the "Free" and "Starter" plan cards, the description text wraps differently. In Image 1, "can do" and "more traffic" are on a new line. In Image 2, the text is more condensed ("Pixelco can do" and "more traffic" stay on the same line as the previous word).
*   **Feature List Wrapping:** The feature text under the pricing (e.g., "100 lifetime identifications", "300 identifications / mo") wraps to two lines in Image 2, whereas it fits on one line in Image 1.
*   **FAQ Section:** In Image 1, the FAQ section shows the first question with an icon. In Image 2, this section is expanded or shifted, showing the text "What counts as an identification?" as a full header with a dropdown arrow, and the layout below it is different.

**Components & Content:**
*   **User Avatar:** The top-right avatar circle contains the letters "**SE**" in Image 1, but "**DE**" in Image 2.
*   **Sidebar Footer:** 
    *   The "FREE" badge background color is a darker orange/gold in Image 2 compared to the lighter yellow in Image 1.
    *   There is a large, dark circular icon with the letter "**N**" overlapping the bottom-left corner of the sidebar in Image 2. This element is completely absent in Image 1.
    *   The "Sign out" link text at the very bottom left is partially obscured by the "N" icon in Image 2.
